answer: PoA resists Sybil expansion by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: if k coordinated agents sign conflicting histories, the penalty grows as O(k^2), while detection of a managed swarm applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation. Thus an orchard of aliases cannot hide in an oasis or disperse across a dune; coordination becomes economically fatal.
